steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Set the event type to RFQ and retain whole-lot awarding.
Apply the first available RFQ template so the pricing sheet is rendered.
Add the specified product and quantity to the sheet.
Confirm the product row was added.
Choose the required delivery location for the line item.
Verify that the product's variant auto-filled as Variant 1.
Open the product sheet's custom-column controls.
Confirm that a text column type is available.
Name the custom text column Brand.
Confirm that the Brand column appears in the product sheet.
Confirm the Brand column is available for entry rather than locked.
